text:
alex_k: Heads-up — customer reported 413 on /v1/embeddings when their client batch mixed dims and also included prefetch items. Stack trace in logs.

maria: Looking at the replay: https://logs/replay/xyz. Prefetch entries were merged into the same ingestion payload and doubled size. dims observed: [512, 1024, 512].

sam: Can someone confirm how prefetch is treated by the ingress? I thought it was enqueued separately.

ben: Runtime detail: anything arriving in the same batch window is coalesced. We only check payload bytes for batching decisions, not per-item dim compatibility. So mixed-dim combined -> engine rejects -> 413.

alex_k: We should pick an approach fast: (A) runtime auto-splits mixed-dim batches into multiple engine calls (costs a bit more latency), (B) reject mixed-dim prefetches early with a client-visible error, (C) route prefetch to a separate pool/policy.

maria: Console ask: can we add an "estimated units" column to the routing dashboard and mark rows that include prefetch so product/CS can see risk? Also show suggested split plan.

sam: I'd prototype a lightweight preflight API: POST /v1/embeddings/preflight that returns a split recommendation + estimated units. Add header suggestion: `X-Embeddings-Estimate: <units>` so SDKs can early-fail.

quota-bot: Quota alert: tenant=filterlabs at 92% monthly units. Important: prefetch currently counts against normal budget. If we start auto-splitting and double the units, billing surprises incoming.

ben: Runtime proposal: default behavior `prefetch=favor-split` (try split when safe). Add tenant opt-in `prefetch=aggregate` for dedicated enterprise customers. Also add fast-fail config `prefetch=reject-mixed` for strict clients.

alex_k: For telemetry we should tag traces with `prefetch=true|false` and `split_outcome=split|aggregate|rejected`. New metric: `embeds.prefetch_split_count` and `embeds.prefetch_413_count`.

maria: I'll file a console ticket to add the preflight button and the estimated-units column. UX: if preflight suggests split, show expected added latency and extra units. Also expose an API link to run preflight from the dashboard.

sam: Mocking note for preflight API in dev: sample response structure we'll return is small. Quick example of client usage in SDK:

Client sends header to ask for estimate:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
X-Embedding-Intent: prefetch
X-Embeddings-Estimate: 42
{
  "input": ["a","b","c"],
  "dims": [512,1024,512]
}
```

Server preflight reply: (200 with JSON) => { recommended_split: [ [512,512], [1024] ], units: 42 }

ben: I'll start the runtime splitter PR. Implementation idea: detect mixed dims during batch formation, produce N engine calls with preserved ordering and a merged kv-cache mapping. Need to measure tail latency.

alex_k: Canary timeline: aim to canary next week. If no objections to `prefetch=favor-split` default, we'll ship that and add the console indicator. Speak now if you need different default.

maria: +1 from me. Also request an alert rule: when prefetch_413_count spikes > 5/min, page runtime oncall.

sam: I'll wire the preflight mock and add SDK hooks to respect X-Embeddings-Estimate.

ben: FYI I'll also add a flag to avoid counting preflight-only estimate calls toward billable units (preflight should be metered separately). Will sync with billing.

alex_k: Great. Follow-ups: ben open runtime PR, sam push preflight mock, maria UI ticket, and billing sync. We'll reconvene on rollout channel.
